description.message: Send links to Arqon, which downloads them over Wi-Fi and your phone's internet at once.

catchAllHint.message: The browser's own download is cancelled and Arqon takes over. Sites that need you to be logged in may not work this way; use the right-click menu for those.

setupHint.message: In Arqon, switch on Settings → "Open torrents and magnet links with Arqon" once, so the browser can start it.
